name: comp-187
title: Switch Payment Toggle
blurb: Switch card with payment brand logo and description.
description: Switch in a card layout with brand logo, label, sublabel, and description. Built on shadcn's Switch.
use_when: Payment method enablement in settings where logo clarifies which method is being toggled.
avoid_when: Simple toggles or when space is very limited.
a11y: Built on accessible Switch primitive with aria-describedby for description text. SVG logo marked aria-hidden.
